description: Both duplicates kept and covered; duplication raised with the PO.

analysis.summary: Stock badge and add-to-cart availability; AC-1 and AC-3 are word-for-word duplicates.

acceptance_criteria.text: The product page shows "In stock" when at least one unit is available.
The product page shows "Out of stock" when no units are available.
The product page shows "In stock" when at least one unit is available.
The "Add to cart" button is disabled when the product is out of stock.

findings.text: AC-1 and AC-3 are identical. Was AC-3 meant to describe a different rule (e.g. low stock)?
Is there a low-stock state between 'In stock' and 'Out of stock'?

risks.title: Out-of-stock product purchasable
risks.description: The button may stay enabled when stock reaches zero.
